study.question: Can replacing only cross-context category/brand pair-distribution alignment with a concentration-only upper bound retain direct_lifted utility and reduce measured cost while preserving full-dimensional embeddings and full-resolution recurrence contexts?
study.hypothesis: The latest full-reference candidate-supplied diagnostics report overlap residual RMS0.0132602 versus repeat0.168720 and context0.127161 on eight diagnostic rows. Source inspection shows four Bx16xL by BxLx16 Gram products and four BxLx16 group selections used only for overlap. Low amplitude is a prioritization clue, not causal evidence or a timing profile. Let p[g,k,x] be the complete-pair empirical distribution in match group g and action-age context k. Replace G[g,i,j]=sum_x p[g,i,x]*p[g,j,x] by U[g,i,j]=sqrt(C[g,i]*C[g,j]), C=sum_x p^2 already computed by the repeat branch; unoccupied contexts have C=0. This discards identity-distribution angle only in the overlap branch and keeps context concentrations. The replacement may retain utility because the other exact recurrence branches preserve useful identity and time information, while omitting four Gram products may lower end-to-end cost. Single-seed amplitude does not establish redundancy.

nearest_work.difference: Keep this entire source prefix, parameterization and all non-overlap feature blocks. Replace only off-diagonal empirical Gram entries with their Cauchy-Schwarz concentration upper bounds; direct execution skips their four matrix products. Full reference remains byte-identical.

DIN uses learned target-conditioned local activation and relaxes weight normalization. Inherit only the broader embedding/pooling/MLP family through existing local code; this study changes a deterministic category-brand recurrence Gram summary, introduces no attention, and is not a DIN reproduction. The local DIN baseline uses normalized attention and field substitutions.

The author README confirms category/brand/behavior histories without item identity. Use category-brand bucket pairs, never claim item recurrence or exact DMR reproduction; publisher full text remains unavailable.

study.proposed_difference: Concentration-only overlap is an information-changing replacement: compute the existing four groups x16 conditional collision masses C, take their outer geometric mean and gather the existing120 off-diagonal context pairs per group. It is an upper bound, not an unbiased approximation. Empty contexts remain exactly zero. Direct execution removes the four grouped Gram products; dense execution computes them but deliberately reads only the identical concentration surrogate. Zero-overlap reads zero through the original bias-free overlap head and removes its Gram computation. All480 input slots and parameter shapes remain allocated; effective information and active capacity differ. No claim of parameter saving, novelty, item identities, input compression, or external-method transfer is made.
predictions: Predeclared utility retention: mean paired-seed validation AUC(candidate-reference)>=-0.0005; mean unweighted Logloss(candidate-reference)<=+0.00010. With one seed, apply these only as screening thresholds, never as established noninferiority. Frozen direct_lifted AUC0.6304316803980214 and Logloss0.19269404064402526 are historical anchors; same-round reference is the paired comparator.

Predeclared efficiency target: >=3% reduction in median training seconds or validation inference seconds relative to same-round full reference, repeated under the unchanged host conditions; all wall times, allocated GPU seconds if supplied, peak memory, examples/sec, p50/p95 latency and parameter counts remain reported. Three paired seeds are targeted; noisy one-run timings remain preliminary. Parameter count should stay17253123 in every arm.

Direct concentration and dense concentration have the same features/logits at fixed weights to float32 tolerance1e-5, but only direct skips the four Gram products. Their trained metrics should agree within seed/numerical variation; exact source execution is the intended causal cost contrast.

Concentration-only replacement should preserve first three recurrence blocks within1e-5. U>=G elementwise on occupied contexts, identical diagonals, U=0 for unoccupied contexts, and equal overlap when two conditional identity distributions are identical. Constructed disjoint one-point distributions give true overlap0 and surrogate1, proving the information loss.

Zero-overlap determines whether a retained nonzero concentration head adds utility beyond simply omitting the overlap signal. If both pass utility and cost gates, prefer zero as simpler; if concentration passes and zero fails, retain the concentration replacement provisionally.
falsifiers: Mean paired AUC loss>0.0005 or Logloss increase>0.00010 fails the utility-retention hypothesis even if timing improves; one-seed screening failure is not a universal refutation.
No reproducible >=3% measured training or inference reduction fails the declared efficiency target; smaller or noisy savings do not establish the proposed frontier improvement.

Any change>1e-5 in a non-overlap block or direct/dense feature/logit mismatch>1e-5 fails implementation isolation. Any bound, support, padding, reversal or empty-history diagnostic error>1e-5 blocks interpretation until repaired, with failed cost retained.

If concentration-only utility is no better than zero-overlap across paired repetitions, evidence does not support concentration as the necessary retained mechanism. Low initial residual amplitude alone is not explanatory proof.
alternative_explanations: Small diagnostic subset and head scale can conceal important ranking information; small RMS does not imply negligible AUC contribution
Same-seed reruns show numerical/implementation and timing variation; previous full_reference0.630413 and shared_full0.630742 differ despite nominally equivalent information
Upper bounds change input scale and correlation as well as identity-angle information; this suite tests their combined replacement effect, not an isolated universal angle mechanism
Existing exact identity/context/transition summaries can partially recover association; the change removes that information only from the overlap branch
Unchanged allocated parameters do not equate functional capacity: the zero branch has dormant weights, while concentration entries lie on a restricted nonlinear manifold
Four Gram products may not dominate end-to-end time; sort, embedding, optimizer, CPU gathering or host noise may dominate, and dense unused operations need host eager execution verification
No authorized receipts or source for pooled_observed/sketch256 are available in this phase; their task names do not license performance or frontier claims
